posts.cooked:
Episode 127 of Letters Page introduced Kid Cosmic, the lead character of the fourth modern animated show Neo-Fighters. I was wondering if the comunity wanted to brainstorm the best build for him in the RPG.

Ben Burton a normal highschool student is bound to an alien weapon that talks in his mind beliveing him to be some space champion. Young Legacy and Unity push him into being a hero wen he just wants to pass high school.

Background- Uperclass                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Ben is suposed to be average, but his school plays tennis for PE and Ben was surprised when Young Legacy and Unity were suddenly his classmates and the sign in front of the school has a large enough lawn that a meteor hitting the sign would not destroy the school so i figure it is a private school not mid-town high. Also subtle class/society story traits "common, blue collar working class" would be more willing to break the mold than "upper middle class, white collar managment" Also it gives a responsibility principal for EVERYMAN

Origin- Relic                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Ben has an alien artifact weapon nuff said                                                                                                                                                                                              Punishment- enemies try to drag him down and he fights twice as hard fits very well with a becoming a hero arc                                                                             Magical Sheild- basic cosmic constructs throwing up a sheild works                                                                                                                                                          Momentary Power- he can power himself up with his weapon

Archtype- Armored                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The Cosmic Cuff forms armor around him "click,click,click" and he is a fighter but not close combat or marksman                                                                                   Armored- core part of glowing space armor                                                                                                                                                                                                 Dual offence/living bulwark/repair- flexible energy construct attacks

Red Zone                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Final Wrath/mental and Ultimatum/social- going with my becoming a hero story his big moves should be finding the power with in himself and his character not learning to use the weapon better        

Personality                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Fast talking- low green + high red matches become the hero, figure he is always making excusses for why he can't be a hero

I figure Kid Cosmic could be a back ground character in Daybreak. My custom charcter Salamander is writen as the leader of another team with an undefined membership and really want to see Kid Cosmic as part of his team. The power sets and personalitys would be good match/contrast

Anyone have any other ideas
